{"path": "/results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_true/level_2/brief/sio2_quenching_2_subtask_quenching_trial_1/quench.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for SiO2 NPT quenching

# Initialization
units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

# Read structure
read_data /results/6_Nov_Optimised/claude_45/tool_calling/quenching/subtask_true/level_2/brief/sio2_quenching_2_subtask_structure_retrieval_trial_1/structure.data

# Potential
pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

# Settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Compute temperature
compute mytemp all temp

# Timestep
timestep 0.001

# Quenching parameters
variable T_initial equal 5000
variable T_final equal 1500
variable quench_rate equal 3.5
variable temp_diff equal ${T_initial}-${T_final}
variable quench_time equal ${temp_diff}/${quench_rate}
variable quench_steps equal ${quench_time}/dt

# NPT quenching
fix npt_quench all npt temp ${T_initial} ${T_final} 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Thermo output
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density vol pe ke etotal

# Run quenching
run ${quench_steps}

# Final output
print "Final density: $(density)"
print "Quenching complete"
"}
